resources.string:
JustSaid works entirely on this phone. It can listen to a phone call, write down what was said, and pull out the tasks and promises for you. Nothing is ever sent to the internet or to us.

Recording calls is not allowed everywhere. In some places you must tell the other person that the call is being recorded, and in some places everyone must agree first.

By tapping “I Agree” you confirm that:

• You will follow the call-recording laws where you live.
• You will get the other person’s permission when it is required.
• You are responsible for how you use what JustSaid writes down.

JustSaid stores everything privately on this phone only. You can delete it at any time.
